Class OrderModificationService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.OrderModificationService
@Service public class OrderModificationService extends Object
Edits an OPEN order in place - quantity, limit or stop price, trail, time in force - keeping its ID and its place in history. The order is locked first, so an edit and OrderTriggerEngine filling it can't both win, and checked as a new order would be: the account must still cover the changed order's cash or shares (less what its other open orders hold), and a stop can't be moved to a price the market has already passed, which would trigger the order at once. Changing the quantity of one exit leg of a bracket changes the other leg's too.

  • Method Details

    • modify

      @Transactional public OpenOrderItem modify(UUID clientId, UUID orderId, ModifyOrderRequest request)
      Applies an edit to one of the client's open orders.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the authenticated client
      orderId - the order to change
      request - what to change
      Returns:
      the order as it now stands
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - not found (404) if the client has no such order, conflict (409) if it is no longer OPEN, bad request (400) if the edit doesn't fit the order's type or the account can't cover it; not found (404) or forbidden (403) as account-app answers for the account, bad request (400) for any other account-app refusal, and service unavailable (503) if account-app can't be reached or fails
